key: It's so nice to be away from the city and just relax.
en: It's so nice to be away from the city and just relax.
ja: 街から離れて、のんびりできるのって本当にいいよね。

key: With Kiki gone, even the sky is a little greyer...
en: With Kiki gone, even the sky is a little greyer...
ja: キキ先生がいないと、空まで少し灰色に見える……

key: No matter what, I can never seem to pack lightly.
en: No matter what, I can never seem to pack lightly.
ja: どうやっても、荷物を軽くまとめるってことができないんだよなあ。

key: Let's see...
en: Let's see...
ja: えーっと……

key: Two pairs of socks, two jackets, two bags of food, the poncho, stove, tent, sleeping bag and blankets...
en: Two pairs of socks, two jackets, two bags of food, the poncho, stove, tent, sleeping bag and blankets...
ja: 靴下2足、ジャケット2着、食料の袋2つ、ポンチョ、コンロ、テント、寝袋と毛布……

key: Three sweaters, two pairs of pants, sandals and hiking boots, Grandmama's good luck charm...
en: Three sweaters, two pairs of pants, sandals and hiking boots, Grandmama's good luck charm...
ja: セーター3枚、ズボン2着、サンダルと登山靴、おばあちゃんのお守り……

key: Grandpappy's good luck charm, Uncle Steve's good luck charm, camera, lantern, Auntie Margret's necklace...
en: Grandpappy's good luck charm, Uncle Steve's good luck charm, camera, lantern, Auntie Margret's necklace...
ja: おじいちゃんのお守り、スティーブおじさんのお守り、カメラ、ランタン、マーグレットおばさんのネックレス……

key: ...which ain't a good luck charm, but I don't got one from her, so we're gonna say it is,
en: ...which ain't a good luck charm, but I don't got one from her, so we're gonna say it is,
ja: ……お守りじゃないけど、彼女からもらったものが他にないから、お守りってことにしとくよ。

key: My journal, the last four issues of Dragon Tamer Monthly, compass, writin' utensils, traveling knife,
en: My journal, the last four issues of Dragon Tamer Monthly, compass, writin' utensils, traveling knife,
ja: 日記帳、「ドラゴンテイマー月刊」の最新4冊、コンパス、筆記用具、旅行用ナイフ、

key: And three changes of undies.
en: And three changes of undies.
ja: それに下着の替え3着。

key: That oughta about do it for an overnight trip, don't you think?
en: That oughta about do it for an overnight trip, don't you think?
ja: これで一泊旅行としては、十分だと思わない?

key: Oh, hey. I don't need this piece.
en: Oh, hey. I don't need this piece.
ja: あ、ちょっと。これはいらないや。

key: Why don't you take it offa my hands?
en: Why don't you take it offa my hands?
ja: よかったら、もらってくれない?

key: A little extra is fine! I'll be ready for whatever the road may throw at me!
en: A little extra is fine! I'll be ready for whatever the road may throw at me!
ja: 多少多いくらいがちょうどいい! 道中何があっても大丈夫なようにね!

key: DUDEBRO: Shit, I think... I pushed myself... too hard, bro...
en: DUDEBRO: Shit, I think... I pushed myself... too hard, bro...
ja: マッチョ兄貴: くそ……追い込みすぎた……気がする……

key: Yo dude... You don't got any Protein, do you?
en: Yo dude... You don't got any Protein, do you?
ja: よお、相棒……プロテインとか持ってねえよな?

key: I ran out, but after a sick workout like that, that shit is just what I need.
en: I ran out, but after a sick workout like that, that shit is just what I need.
ja: 切らしちまってさ、あんだけキメたトレーニングのあとには、それが一番必要なんだよ。

key: If you got any, give a brother a hand.
en: If you got any, give a brother a hand.
ja: もし持ってたら、兄弟に恵んでくれよ。

key: Give him a Protein?
en: Give him a Protein?
ja: プロテインをあげる?

key: \PN handed over the Protein.
en: \PN handed over the Protein.
ja: \PNはプロテインをゆずった。

key: DUDEBRO: Sweeeeet!
en: DUDEBRO: Sweeeeet!
ja: マッチョ兄貴: マジサイコー!

key: Dudebro ate the Protein all at once!
en: Dudebro ate the Protein all at once!
ja: マッチョ兄貴はプロテインを一気に食べた!

key: DUDEBRO: Yo, I'd heard that Victoria girl lecturing some of the chicks here on some shit about this beach.
en: DUDEBRO: Yo, I'd heard that Victoria girl lecturing some of the chicks here on some shit about this beach.
ja: マッチョ兄貴: よお、あのヴィクトリアって女がここの女子たちに、この浜辺の何かについて講義してたの聞いたぜ。

key: DUDEBRO: Yo, I'd heard that Kiki girl lecturing some of the chicks here on some shit about this beach.
en: DUDEBRO: Yo, I'd heard that Kiki girl lecturing some of the chicks here on some shit about this beach.
ja: マッチョ兄貴: よお、あのキキって女がここの女子たちに、この浜辺の何かについて講義してたの聞いたぜ。

key: I accidentally picked up a digital copy of the lecture, so lemme hook you up, bro.
en: I accidentally picked up a digital copy of the lecture, so lemme hook you up, bro.
ja: たまたま講義のデジタルコピーを手に入れたから、お前にもわけてやるよ、相棒。

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 20!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 20!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解説書20を手に入れた!

key: Info on Ashen Beach now available!
en: Info on Ashen Beach now available!
ja: 灰の浜辺の情報が見られるようになった!

key: DUDEBRO: Weak!
en: DUDEBRO: Weak!
ja: マッチョ兄貴: 情けねえ!

key: DUDEBRO: Dude, that Victoria girl has some good shit goin' on here.
en: DUDEBRO: Dude, that Victoria girl has some good shit goin' on here.
ja: マッチョ兄貴: なあ、あのヴィクトリアって女、この辺でなかなかいいこと言ってるぜ。

key: DUDEBRO: Dude, that Kiki girl has some good shit goin' on here.
en: DUDEBRO: Dude, that Kiki girl has some good shit goin' on here.
ja: マッチョ兄貴: なあ、あのキキって女、この辺でなかなかいいこと言ってるぜ。

key: I was like, talking to her about whatever, right? And she said the dopest shit, like...
en: I was like, talking to her about whatever, right? And she said the dopest shit, like...
ja: なんかさ、いろいろ話してたときに、めちゃくちゃイケてること言っててさ……

key: I forget how she put it, but basically she said it's important not to skip leg day because then the legs in my MIND would get weaker, bro.
en: I forget how she put it, but basically she said it's important not to skip leg day because then the legs in my MIND would get weaker, bro.
ja: どう言ってたか忘れちまったけど、要するに、脚トレをサボると「心の中の脚」まで弱くなるから大事だ、みたいなことだったな。

key: Like, I guess it's willpower or whatever that bullshit is, but it WORKS, dude, you gotta try it.
en: Like, I guess it's willpower or whatever that bullshit is, but it WORKS, dude, you gotta try it.
ja: なんつーか、意志力とかそういうわけ分かんないやつだと思うけど、実際効くんだよ、相棒。マジで試してみろって。

key: I came here because training under a master sounded exciting, but there's nothing to DO here!
en: I came here because training under a master sounded exciting, but there's nothing to DO here!
ja: 師匠のもとで修行するのって聞いたときはワクワクしたのに、ここじゃマジで何もやることねえ!

key: I mean, I thought for sure we'd get TVs in our rooms at least. What kind of place is this?!
en: I mean, I thought for sure we'd get TVs in our rooms at least. What kind of place is this?!
ja: てか、少なくとも部屋にテレビくらいあると思ってたのに。ここ、一体どういう場所だよ?!

key: Actually, now that I think about it, isn't there one somewhere around here?
en: Actually, now that I think about it, isn't there one somewhere around here?
ja: つーか、よく考えたら、この辺のどっかにあったりしねえか?

key: Hey, you! Since you're standing there listening to me whine, if you see a TV nearby, come bring it to me!
en: Hey, you! Since you're standing there listening to me whine, if you see a TV nearby, come bring it to me!
ja: おい、お前! せっかくオレの愚痴聞いてくれてんだから、この辺でテレビ見つけたら持ってきてくれよ!

key: If you see a TV laying around anywhere near here, bring it to me!
en: If you see a TV laying around anywhere near here, bring it to me!
ja: この近くにテレビが転がってたら、持ってきてくれよな!

key: Oh my god.
en: Oh my god.
ja: うそだろ。

key: You actually did it.
en: You actually did it.
ja: 本当に持ってきやがった。

key: You actually brought me a TV.
en: You actually brought me a TV.
ja: マジでテレビ持ってきてくれるとはな。

key: You just picked up the whole fucking TV and just carried it down here-- Who does that?!
en: You just picked up the whole fucking TV and just carried it down here-- Who does that?!
ja: テレビまるごとかついで、ここまで運んできたのかよ――誰がそんなことすんだよ?!

key: I don't know but YOU ROCK!
en: I don't know but YOU ROCK!
ja: よく分かんねえけど、お前サイコーだな!

key: Quick, set it down over there! We'll pretend it was here the whole time.
en: Quick, set it down over there! We'll pretend it was here the whole time.
ja: 早く、そこに置いてくれ! ずっと前からここにあったフリしよう。

key: I didn't think you would actually do it!
en: I didn't think you would actually do it!
ja: マジでやってくれるとは思ってなかったよ!

key: This is so cool! I hope I don't get in trouble...
en: This is so cool! I hope I don't get in trouble...
ja: これサイコーじゃん! 怒られなきゃいいけど……

key: I'll just blame you if I do, okay?
en: I'll just blame you if I do, okay?
ja: もし怒られたら、お前のせいにしとくからな、いいな?

key: In return, you can have this.
en: In return, you can have this.
ja: お礼に、これをやるよ。

key: It's for Obsidia's Department Store, but I never go there anymore anyway.
en: It's for Obsidia's Department Store, but I never go there anymore anyway.
ja: オブシディアのデパート用だけど、もうあそこには全然行かないから。

key: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker: Meditite!
en: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker: Meditite!
ja: \PNはデパートシール「アサナン」を手に入れた!

key: Huh? Don't you have a Membership Card? Lame.
en: Huh? Don't you have a Membership Card? Lame.
ja: あれ? 会員カード持ってねえの? だっせ。

key: Go get one and then come back here so I can give you a Sticker!
en: Go get one and then come back here so I can give you a Sticker!
ja: 取ってきてから、また来いよ。そしたらシールやるから!

key: Why is there only static on TV...?
en: Why is there only static on TV...?
ja: なんでテレビが砂嵐しか映さねえんだ……?

key: Do they not get reception here now...?
en: Do they not get reception here now...?
ja: この辺、もう電波届いてねえのか……?

key: Actually, it turns out there's nothing good on TV anyway...
en: Actually, it turns out there's nothing good on TV anyway...
ja: てか、どうせテレビにはろくな番組やってねえけどな……

key: SAGE: Hello there!
en: SAGE: Hello there!
ja: セージ: こんにちは!

key: SAGE: Have you come to have one of your Pokémon's Hidden Power divined?
en: SAGE: Have you come to have one of your Pokémon's Hidden Power divined?
ja: セージ: あなたのポケモンのめざめるパワーを占いに来たのですか?

key: ???: Oh, hello there!
en: ???: Oh, hello there!
ja: ???: ああ、こんにちは!

key: I am a special Trainer with a unique psychic power. People call me the Sage, as I have the ability to discern a Pokémon's hidden potential.
en: I am a special Trainer with a unique psychic power.  People call me the Sage, as I have the ability to discern a Pokémon's hidden potential.
ja: 私は特別な力を持つトレーナー、ポケモンの秘めた可能性を見抜くことができるので、皆からセージと呼ばれています。

key: SAGE: Would you like me to do so for one of your Pokémon?
en: SAGE: Would you like me to do so for one of your Pokémon?
ja: セージ: あなたのポケモンの一体を、占って差し上げましょうか?

key: Whose hidden potential shall I determine?
en: Whose hidden potential shall I determine?
ja: どのポケモンの隠れた可能性を、占いましょうか?

key: Ah, changed your mind?
en: Ah, changed your mind?
ja: あら、気が変わりましたか?

key: All right. Perhaps some other time I can display my talent for you.
en: All right. Perhaps some other time I can display my talent for you.
ja: 分かりました。またの機会に、この力をお見せしましょう。

key: This power is far too dangerous to be used on an Egg!
en: This power is far too dangerous to be used on an Egg!
ja: この力は、タマゴに使うにはあまりに危険すぎます!

key: Would you like me to check another Pokémon?
en: Would you like me to check another Pokémon?
ja: 別のポケモンを占いましょうか?

key: FELICIA: Say, what?
en: FELICIA: Say, what?
ja: フェリシア: はぁ、何?

key: Oh, hold on a sec, let me turn off my music.
en: Oh, hold on a sec, let me turn off my music.
ja: あ、ちょっと待って、音楽切るから。

key: I can't hear anything through these headphones, TBH.
en: I can't hear anything through these headphones, TBH.
ja: このヘッドホンつけてると、マジで何も聞こえないんだよね。

key: Okay, did you need something?
en: Okay, did you need something?
ja: オッケー、何か用?

key: Oh! You're the one who came out about the Pokémon?
en: Oh! You're the one who came out about the Pokémon?
ja: あ! あなた、あのポケモンのことで出てきた人?

key: Yes, yesyesyes!
en: Yes, yesyesyes!
ja: そうそうそうそう!

key: Ever since DJ Arclight contacted me about this, I've been SO psyched!
en: Ever since DJ Arclight contacted me about this, I've been SO psyched!
ja: DJアークライトからこの件で連絡もらってから、もうめっちゃテンション上がってるんだ!

key: Listen,
en: Listen,
ja: あのさ、

key: Set the Pokémon aside for a second.
en: Set the Pokémon aside for a second.
ja: ポケモンのことはちょっと置いといて。

key: I need you to do me a favor.
en: I need you to do me a favor.
ja: お願いがあるの。

key: Could you get his autograph for me?! Please?!
en: Could you get his autograph for me?! Please?!
ja: 彼のサイン、もらってきてくれない?! お願い!?

key: I listen to his show like, ALL the time. It's the only thing that got me through school nights!
en: I listen to his show like, ALL the time. It's the only thing that got me through school nights!
ja: あの人の番組、マジでいつも聴いてるんだから。学校がある夜を乗り切れたの、あれのおかげなんだよ!

key: I NEED this.
en: I NEED this.
ja: これ、絶対必要なの。

key: We can worry about the Pokémon afterwards, just get me that beautiful specimen of a man's autograph!
en: We can worry about the Pokémon afterwards, just get me that beautiful specimen of a man's autograph!
ja: ポケモンのことは後で心配するから、とにかくあの美しすぎる男のサインをもらってきて!

key: FELICIA: Didja get it, didja get it?!
en: FELICIA: Didja get it, didja get it?!
ja: フェリシア: もらえた? もらえた!?

key: \PN handed over DJ Arclight's Autograph.
en: \PN handed over DJ Arclight's Autograph.
ja: \PNはDJアークライトのサインをわたした。

key: FELICIA: Yes, yes yes Yes Yes YES YES!!!
en: FELICIA: Yes, yes yes Yes Yes YES YES!!!
ja: フェリシア: やった、やったやったやったやったやった!!!

key: Thank you, thank you so much! You're my hero!
en: Thank you, thank you so much! You're my hero!
ja: ありがとう、本当にありがとう! あなた、あたしのヒーローだよ!

key: Well, he's my hero.
en: Well, he's my hero.
ja: まあ、彼こそがあたしのヒーローなんだけど。

key: But you're my hero-by-proxy!
en: But you're my hero-by-proxy!
ja: でもあなたは、あたしの代理ヒーロー!

key: I will treasure this until the day I die.
en: I will treasure this until the day I die.
ja: これは死ぬまで大事にする。

key: FELICIA: Huh, you again?
en: FELICIA: Huh, you again?
ja: フェリシア: あれ、また来たの?

key: Did you need something?
en: Did you need something?
ja: 何か用?

key: Oh, right. Didn't you have my Pokémon?
en: Oh, right. Didn't you have my Pokémon?
ja: あ、そうだ。あたしのポケモン持ってたよね?

key: FELICIA: Huh, wait... This one isn't mine.
en: FELICIA: Huh, wait... This one isn't mine.
ja: フェリシア: あれ、待って……これ、あたしのじゃない。

key: Are you sure you didn't get something mixed up?
en: Are you sure you didn't get something mixed up?
ja: 何か取り違えてない、大丈夫?

key: FELICIA: Ahah, man, I almost forgot about this little guy.
en: FELICIA: Ahah, man, I almost forgot about this little guy.
ja: フェリシア: ああ、やば、この子のこと、危うく忘れるとこだった。

key: Thanks so much! I won't let him out of my sight again!
en: Thanks so much! I won't let him out of my sight again!
ja: 本当にありがとう! もう二度と目を離さないから!

key: Well, metaphorically, you know?
en: Well, metaphorically, you know?
ja: まあ、比喩的にだけどね?

key: She can't hear you at all over her music.
en: She can't hear you at all over her music.
ja: 彼女には、音楽で全く聞こえていないようだ。

key: FELICIA: Oh, it's you again. Hold on.
en: FELICIA: Oh, it's you again. Hold on.
ja: フェリシア: あ、また来たんだ。ちょっと待って。

key: What's up?
en: What's up?
ja: 何か用?

key: Hey, why are you staring at my headphones like that?
en: Hey, why are you staring at my headphones like that?
ja: ねえ、なんでそんなにあたしのヘッドホン見てるの?

key: I mean, yeah, they're super rad and noise-cancelling, but come on.
en: I mean, yeah, they're super rad and noise-cancelling, but come on.
ja: そりゃ、めちゃくちゃイケてるし、ノイズキャンセリングだけどさ。

key: Don't tell me you want them or something!
en: Don't tell me you want them or something!
ja: まさか欲しいとか言わないよね!?

key: Listen, these are precious to me. There's no way I'd part with them!
en: Listen, these are precious to me. There's no way I'd part with them!
ja: あのね、これはあたしにとって大事なものなの。絶対に手放せない!

key: The only thing that I would ever trade them for would be an autograph from Master McKrezzy himself!
en: The only thing that I would ever trade them for would be an autograph from Master McKrezzy himself!
ja: 唯一これと引き換えにしてもいいものがあるとしたら、マスター・マクレジー本人のサインくらいかな!

key: I've been a fan of his ever since the Wonderstars tour!
en: I've been a fan of his ever since the Wonderstars tour!
ja: 「ワンダースターズ」ツアーからずっとファンなんだから!

key: No! I've been his BIGGEST fan since then!
en: No! I've been his BIGGEST fan since then!
ja: ううん! それ以来、あたしが一番のファンだから!

key: I would give up my body and soul for that man, and all that implies!
en: I would give up my body and soul for that man, and all that implies!
ja: あの人のためなら、体も心も差し出してもいい、その意味も込めて!

key: Headphones for his autograph? Hell yeah!
en: Headphones for his autograph? Hell yeah!
ja: サインとヘッドホン交換? 全然アリ!

key: ...But that's just hypothetical. There's no way someone like you could get that.
en: ...But that's just hypothetical. There's no way someone like you could get that.
ja: ……でもそんなの、あくまでたとえ話。あなたみたいな人が手に入れられるわけないし。

key: And I won't settle for anything less! So hmph!
en: And I won't settle for anything less! So hmph!
ja: それ以下じゃ絶対に納得しないから! だからふん!

key: FELICIA: Hey, I already said--
en: FELICIA: Hey, I already said--
ja: フェリシア: ちょっと、もう言ったでしょ――

key: \PN flashed McKrezzy's Autograph.
en: \PN flashed McKrezzy's Autograph.
ja: \PNはマクレジーのサインを見せた。

key: FELICIA: ...
en: FELICIA: ...
ja: フェリシア: ……

key: O. M. G.
en: O. M. G.
ja: う、そ、で、しょ。

key: Felicia snatched McKrezzy's Autograph!
en: Felicia snatched McKrezzy's Autograph!
ja: フェリシアはマクレジーのサインをひったくった!

key: FELICIA: Just... take it and go.
en: FELICIA: Just... take it and go.
ja: フェリシア: とにかく……もらって、行って。

key: I have a starry-eyed shock to wallow in for approximately thirty seconds before I start hailing you with questions.
en: I have a starry-eyed shock to wallow in for approximately thirty seconds before I start hailing you with questions.
ja: あと30秒くらい、うっとりぼう然としてから、質問攻めにするから。

key: Run while you still can.
en: Run while you still can.
ja: 今のうちに逃げて。

key: FELICIA: There's no way I'm going to part with these headphones!
en: FELICIA: There's no way I'm going to part with these headphones!
ja: フェリシア: このヘッドホンだけは、絶対に手放さないから!

key: But there's no way someone like you could get that.
en: But there's no way someone like you could get that.
ja: でもどうせ、あなたみたいな人には手に入らないでしょ。

key: FELICIA: What was he like?
en: FELICIA: What was he like?
ja: フェリシア: 彼、どんな感じだった?

key: Was he pretty?
en: Was he pretty?
ja: かっこよかった?

key: Did you touch him?
en: Did you touch him?
ja: 触った?

key: What did he smell like?
en: What did he smell like?
ja: どんな匂いだった?

key: Was he wearing his stage outfit?
en: Was he wearing his stage outfit?
ja: ステージ衣装、着てた?

key: Where did you meet him?
en: Where did you meet him?
ja: どこで会ったの?

key: Can I get his number?
en: Can I get his number?
ja: 彼の電話番号、もらえる?

key: Can I get your number?
en: Can I get your number?
ja: あなたの電話番号、もらえる?

key: If I get your number can we do a three-way with him?
en: If I get your number can we do a three-way with him?
ja: あなたの番号もらえたら、彼と三人で通話できたりする?

key: Uh-- three-way call, I meant.
en: Uh-- three-way call, I meant.
ja: あ――三人通話ね、って意味。

key: Tch, the bunks in this place are so bare-bones.
en: Tch, the bunks in this place are so bare-bones.
ja: ちっ、この場所のベッド、ほんと質素だよね。

key: Can a girl get a cloonie up in here?
en: Can a girl get a cloonie up in here?
